Name: Yagisan's Clint Shop Expanded
Author: Yagichan
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=5]Yagisan's Clint Shop Expanded[/size]

As your friendship with Clint grows, and certain events take place in the valley, Clint's stock selection will grow.
Stock availability may vary from day to day. This depends on your daily luck.

[list]
[*] 0 Hearts: Iron Fence
[*] 0 Hearts: Sprinkler
[*] 1 Heart: Charcoal Kiln
[*] 2 Hearts: Quality Sprinkler
[*] 3 Hearts: Lightning Rod
[*] 3 Hearts: Furnace
[*] 4 Hearts: Seed Maker
[*] 6 Hearts: Heavy Furnace
[*] 8 Hearts: Iridium Ore
[*] 8 Hearts - Visited Mr. Qi's Walnut Room: Radioactive Ore
[/list][list]
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size][/list][/font]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][font=Verdana]
